name: JG_ZZ_AR_AP_TRNOVR_DECL_HDRS
description: This table stores the turnover report extraction process parameter information which provides a history of the report runs. It also contains declaration information about the reports submitted in final mode to the tax

columns.name: DECL_HEADER_ID
columns.description: A unique system generated identifier for the header record that is associated with the turnover declaration.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that identifies the legal entity for which the extract is run.

columns.name: CALENDAR
columns.description: Indicates the name of the calendar.

columns.name: PERIOD_FROM
columns.description: Name of the start period for which data is extracted.

columns.name: PERIOD_TO
columns.description: Name of the end period for which data is extracted.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the start date of the period.

columns.name: PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the end date of the period.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the source of the transaction. For example, sales or purchase transaction.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Source application module that created this record. For example, spanish modelo or italian sales listing extraction.

columns.name: DATA_EXTRACT_MODE
columns.description: Indicates the extraction mode. The valid values are Draft or Final.

columns.name: SELECTION_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the status of the turnover reporting selection process run.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
